prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ createAccessDialog }`.

`createAccessDialog(checkCredentials)` requires a function and otherwise throws `TypeError`. It returns `{ open, close, getState, submit }`. State is `{ visible, busy, message }`, initially `{ false, false, null }`. `open()` and `close()` change visibility; `close()` also clears the message. Both return defensive state copies.

`submit(credentials)` requires the dialog to be visible and not busy. Credentials must be a non-null object with non-empty string `user` and `secret` fields. Invalid credentials resolve to state with message `'invalid input'` without calling the checker. A valid submission sets `busy` while awaiting `checkCredentials` with a copied credentials object. A reply must have an integer `code`. Code 204 closes the dialog and sets message `'accepted'`; code 401 leaves it open with `'denied'`; code 409 leaves it open with `'retry later'`; any other code or malformed reply leaves it open with `'service error'`. Checker rejection also produces `'service error'`. `submit` must resolve, not reject.

While busy, another `submit` must resolve immediately to the current state without invoking the checker. No input, reply, or returned state may alias mutable internal state. Export with `module.exports` only.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
